newsitem.title: USA: US semiconductor Dec book-to-bill ratio up at 1.02.
newsitem.headline: US semiconductor Dec book-to-bill ratio up at 1.02.

text.p: The North American semiconductor equipment industry posted a December book-to-bill ratio of 1.02, up from November's revised ratio of 0.90, according to an international trade association.
The ratio means $102 in orders were received for each $100 worth of products shipped.

Semiconductor Equipment and Materials International (SEMI) said late on Thursday that semiconductor orders in December rose 11 percent over November to $1.04 billion. But the bookings were 19.5 percent below those of December 1995, SEMI said.

Total semiconductor equipment shipped by North American suppliers dropped to $1.02 billion, about three percent below November's level, SEMI said. The association said December shipments were 17 percent below 1995 levels.
